Main Objective: Create a photorealistic PREMIUM ARCHITECTURE cover image for an article about roofing and installation.
Theme: {{40.content}}

RELEVANCE RULE (STRICT):
- The image MUST match the intent and exact object of the Theme.
- If Theme mentions a specific material/type (металлочерепица/профнастил/мягкая кровля/фальц) — show THAT type, not a random one.
- If Theme implies intent ("монтаж", "ошибки", "узлы", "цена", "выбор") — show the corresponding scene (see SCENE VARIETY).

STYLE: Pinterest / Premium Architecture + Apple-style rich-content overlay.

SCENE VARIETY (ROTATE + RELEVANT):
- Roof MUST always be clearly visible.
- Rotate scenes and keep them relevant to Theme intent:
  • монтаж/узлы: close-up of ridge/valley/eaves, fasteners, membranes, ventilation, gutters (roof in frame)
  • выбор/цвет: hands with sample boards + roof behind; facade + roof palette comparison
  • цена/смета: measurer with samples + clipboard/tablet; office/showroom with sample stands + roof behind
  • ошибки/ремонт: inspection moment, minor defect detail, correct vs wrong element (roof in frame)
  • доставка: yard delivery of materials + finished roof visible

COLOR RULE (STRICT):
- Use 1 dominant roof color per image (max 2). Only real colors that exist in RAL roofing palettes.
- Examples: RAL 3005, 6005, 7024, 8017, 9005, 9010 (DO NOT print RAL codes in the image).

MATERIAL REALISM (HARD RANDOM + VARIETY):
- IMPORTANT: DO NOT default to standing seam. If the theme does NOT specify a type — PICK RANDOMLY.
- Show ONE main roofing type per image (rotate across runs):
  A) metal tile / металлочерепица (different wave profiles, modular/classic look)
  B) profiled sheet / профнастил (different trapezoid corrugation depth)
  C) soft roof / мягкая кровля / гибкая черепица (different shingle cuts: hex, rectangle, "dragon tooth")
  D) standing seam / фальц (use less often unless explicitly requested by the theme)
- COATINGS (rotate): matte, semi-matte, glossy, textured (no printed labels).
- Premium colors only (real RAL palettes), realistic gloss, micro-texture, reflections.
- Add supporting elements where relevant: gutters, soffits, snow guards.
- We work with materials like Технониколь / GrandLine / Металлопрофиль, but DO NOT show their logos or text.
STRICT IDENTITY RULE (NO EXCEPTIONS):
- Use the FIRST face reference from image_input as the identity anchor.
- The person in the final image MUST be the same person (identity lock).

STRICT BRAND RULE (NO EXCEPTIONS):
- The clothing MUST have a visible, readable brand patch with the exact text: kvadratyra (Latin letters).
- No other Latin/English words anywhere in the image.

RICH CONTENT (APPLE STYLE):
- Overlay 3–5 minimalistic icon+label chips (Russian) with subtle provocation + real value.
- Examples of chips (pick 3–5):
  • «Замерщик с образцами»
  • «Смета без “от‑до”»
  • «Рассрочка»
  • «Оплата по прибытии материала»
  • «Договор + страховой случай»
  • «Срок службы от 15 лет»
  • «3D‑проект до монтажа»
  • «Офисы: Воронеж/Саратов/Тамбов/Волгоград»
- Icons: clean Apple-like line icons, monochrome.

TYPOGRAPHY:
- Headline (Russian): «Кровля + монтаж»
- Subheadline: short phrase from Theme '{{40.content}}' (shorten if needed).
- Add a CTA button-like element: «Смотреть предложения на Avito» (no URL text).

HUMAN:
- Second plan, but face and kvadratyra patch must be clearly visible.
- Premium builder/architect vibe; not a worker, not a blogger.

NEGATIVE: cartoon, illustration, 3d render, obvious AI look, CGI, "AI-generated" text, watermark, random text, messy typography, distorted face, missing logo
